description: Designer Jan Christian Delfs is both a coffee and tea lover, which is evident in the beautifully formed vessels he has created for the WMF Coffee Time and Tea Time collections. For fans of a pure coffee aroma, WMF offers the French Press Cafetière and the innovative Light Brew Coffee Pot with permanent aroma honeycomb filter. The pots come with a paddle for stirring. The range includes matching coffee cups and latte macchiato glasses. Made of heat-resistant glass with or without a handle, your coffee will stay warm for longer. The round stainless steel tray can be used for bringing the sugar bowl and cream jug safely to the coffee table, where drinks are then served in the Tea Time Collection. The tea service also includes a French Tea Press with warmer, tea cups, a cream jug and a sugar bowl, as well as an iced tea pitcher with iced tea glasses. The coffee / tea storage jar with measuring spoon rounds off the collection. All items can be combined with one another. The material mix of heat-resistant glass, Cromargan® and plastic has become synonymous with quality and the highest pleasure. Whether on the internet, in magazines or at exhibitions, the trend for hand brewed coffee continues to grow. The Coffee Time range from WMF offers coffee lovers individual possibilities for its preparation. The achievement of this range was highlighted by the jury of the German Design Award: “WMF Coffee Time is an exceptionally beautiful and functional coffee range, which shifts the coffee ceremony to the table, adding an aesthetic appeal to the taste experience.”-
